findings.title: attempt_id path traversal succeeds and relocates durable evidence outside the contract state root
findings.evidence: Both ../../ESCAPED and an absolute attempt_id completed successfully and wrote receipt/terminal outside the bound state root.
findings.required_repair: Reject unsafe authorization_id and attempt_id grammar; bind attempt_id to committed human approval/contract authority before execution.

findings.title: CI builds a synthetic binary it does not run
findings.disposition: Pinned committed binary is independently SHA-bound and checkpoint-unreachable; close source/binary reproducibility alongside future build rebind.

findings.title: Prior review incorrectly stated zero path overlap for disclosed diagnostics
findings.disposition: All paths overlap after HOME expansion, but D0 froze first and grant has no tolerances; correct rationale in later assurance evidence.

findings.title: Zero-checkpoint fields are structural constants rather than measured counters
findings.disposition: Checkpoint unreachability is structurally enforced; bind a real I/O-boundary counter before real P1.

findings.title: Historical master ledger is object-graph-bound rather than copied into the native head
findings.disposition: Exact historical commit/path/SHA and receipt continuity were independently confirmed; preserve cross-branch authority binding.

findings.title: CI semantically re-derives but cannot byte-rederive the contract-bound qualification artifact
findings.disposition: Execution code is unchanged between evidence and repair head; semantic fields and summaries independently match.
